objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-spearphishing-attachment-connect-to-none-ms-office-domain
objects.description: The following analytic identifies suspicious Office documents that connect to non-Microsoft Office domains. It leverages Sysmon EventCode 22 to detect processes like winword.exe or excel.exe making DNS queries to domains outside of *.office.com or *.office.net. This activity is significant as it may indicate a spearphishing attempt using malicious documents to download or connect to harmful content.
